ref.substituent_description: Pyrrolidine-type five-membered ring fused to a pyridine: ring N1 bears Ac; C2 (adjacent to N1) bears EtOOC; C3 is an unsubstituted CH2 next to the lower fusion carbon. In the pyridine, the ring N is separated by one CH from the fusion carbon bonded to N1, and OMe is on the carbon adjacent to the ring N.
ref.notes: Typeset. Three double bonds in the six-membered ring (two C=C, one C=N).

wrong.substituent_description: Five-membered ring: N(Ac), then an unsubstituted CH2 vertex, then the carbon bearing EtOOC, which is bonded to the lower fusion carbon (C3 position). Six-membered ring (circle): ring N separated by one CH from the fusion carbon bonded to N(Ac); OMe on the carbon adjacent to the ring N.
wrong.notes: Handwritten black ink on grey paper. Ac written with an upper-case-looking c, still readable as Ac.

correct.substituent_description: Five-membered ring: N(Ac), C2 bearing EtOOC (adjacent to N), CH2, then the fusion carbons. Six-membered ring (circle): ring N separated by one CH from the fusion carbon bonded to N(Ac); OMe on the carbon adjacent to the ring N.
correct.notes: Handwritten black ink. Small ink blobs at the EtOOC and OMe vertices are pen marks, not wedges.

errors_in_wrong.description: The reference has EtOOC on C2 of the five-membered ring, directly adjacent to N(Ac); the wrong drawing places EtOOC on C3 (the carbon bonded to the lower ring-fusion carbon), with an unsubstituted CH2 between N(Ac) and the EtOOC-bearing carbon.

review_notes: Wrong drawing moves the ethyl ester from C2 (next to N-Ac) to C3 of the five-membered ring; the pyridine N and OMe positions are right. The corrected drawing puts EtOOC back on C2 and matches the reference. Aromatic ring drawn as a circle in both handwritten versions (same compound).
